inlines.v: COMBUSTIBLE, adjective That will take fire and burn; capable of catching fire; thus, wood and coal are combustible bodies. COMBUSTIBLE, noun A substance that will take fire and burn; a body which, in its rapid union with others, disengages heat and light.
